newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Railtrack options active as stock climbs.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Railtrack options active as stock climbs.

text.p: Options in Britain's newly privatised rail infrastructure group Railtrack were active for a second session as the underlying shares climbed.

Talk of U.S. interest continued to fuel activity, dealers said, and on the options market dealers noted the sale of 2,000 December 300 calls on Railtrack at 13-1/2p, just as the underlying shares rose to the day's high of 298p.
It was unclear whether the calls were sold against shares.
"I doubt (the trade) represents a view on the shares. I think someone out there just wants to collect (options) premium," said one dealer.
Railtrack shares, which set a record at 300p yesterday, were up 4-1/2p at 289p at 1307 GMT on turnover of 7.2 million shares.
There has been strong interest from U.S. investors recently, spawning rumours of U.S. stake building and feeding the rally.

One analyst said dealers' interest had been heightened by speculation about the value of Railtrack's property holdings and its better-than-expected performance in relation to government financial targets.
Trading in other options markets was sparse, with most activity in FTSE options involving rolling over positions ahead of next week's expiration of September options, dealers said.
September equity and FTSE options expire on September 18 and September 20, respectively.
